title: Sim Chamber
description: Once your model is <positive>Basic</positive> or higher, you can use the <keyword>Simulation Chamber</keyword> to run simulations. Simulations will always produce a <property>generalized prediction</property>, and may also produce a <keyword>Mob Prediction</keyword>, based on the <property>accuracy</property> of the model. The <keyword>higher tier</keyword> of the model, the higher the accuracy, up to <keyword>99.5% at Self Aware</keyword>. Running simulations requires <property>energy</property> (based on the model type) and a <property>catalyst item</property>, which is usually a <keyword>Prediction Matrix</keyword>.
